description: The provided pie chart illustrates the distribution of various video types across a total of fourteen distinct categories. The chart does not utilize a separate legend; instead, category labels are positioned outside the pie adjacent to their respective segments, while the corresponding percentage values are displayed directly inside each slice. There are no visually emphasized, offset, or exploded segments, and the slices do not appear to be arranged in any specific size-based numerical order. Reading clockwise starting from the top right, the categories are distributed as follows: "People Blogs" is represented by an orange slice at 17.2%, "Music" in light purple at 2.3%, "Autos Vehicles" in pinkish-red at 4.8%, "Pets Animals" in green at 3.9%, and "News Politics" in orange at 4.3%. Continuing clockwise, "Science Technology" is shown in blue at 6.4%, "Comedy" in cyan at 5.6%, "Travel Events" in yellow-green at 4.6%, "Gaming" in grey at 6.4%, and "Sports" in pink at 7.7%. The remaining segments consist of "Film Animation" in brown at 4.6%, "Entertainment" in lavender at 13.9%, "Education" in coral at 8.7%, and "Howto Style" in green at 9.7%.
